channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27: About 86% of this outline lies inside Assessor lot…
item.description: About 86% of this outline lies inside Assessor lot 8723002, the lot OCII's plan gives Park P27, at the northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets. The page is renamed Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27 (it was labelled P26) and the old address redirects. It is now shown as planned, not complete: OCII's September 2023 transition presentation lists P27 among the parcels Rec and Park will manage "when built", and no source read says it was built. The outline is unchanged; it covers 61% of the lot, so the lot's own lines are not used. Source: Successor Agency to the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency, Mission Bay North and South Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment A, page 11 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf), row 32 "Park P26 | North side of Mariposa between Owens and 4th Streets | 8723-003, 004, 006, 007(p) | 87,556" and row 33 "Park P27 | Northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets | 8723-002 | 15,246"; OCII, Mission Bay Open Space Transition presentation, September 2023, slide 5 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf): "RPD will manage NP1-NP5; P1, P2 Parking Lot Landscaping, P3, P5, P6, P10, P11/11A, P16, P17 & P26 (Plus P2/P8, P7, P9, P12, P13, P15 and P27 when built)".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27: Mariposa Park (OCII's P26) is described by Potrero…
item.description: Mariposa Park (OCII's P26) is described by Potrero View in March 2016 as "more than two acres" and as about to open "this spring"; no source read dates the actual opening. The 2015 Long-Range Property Management Plan lists Park P26 at 87,556 square feet. Source: https://www.potreroview.net/mariposa-park-set-to-open/ ; https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mariposa-Park-451 ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27: P26 is now a narrower triangle bounded by the…
item.description: P26 is now a narrower triangle bounded by the continuation of The Exchange on 16th's curved edges. Source: Esri World Imagery, viewed 2026-10-10.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27: The record's summary described the wedge as part…
item.description: The record's summary described the wedge as part of a 16th/3rd/Owens interchange next to the UCSF Medical Center, with no outside source. It now states only what is supported: the shape's location near Owens and Mariposa Streets, its appearance in USDA NAIP imagery, and that OCII's December 2015 map places P26 at Mariposa St. The map shape gained a dated flag and a citation but no change to its name, status or use, since whether it is P26 or P27 remains an open question. Source: USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf).
